linkHome.rights: Linking gives this cloud account no rights in the home by itself: it signs you in as your home account, to watch. Only a home admin can allow managing the home through the cloud, for their own link, on the home. You can unlink it on the home's Account page at any time.

homes.rights: The home decides what you can do there: you are your own account on it, watching only through the cloud unless you are an admin of the home who allowed managing for your own link.

install.syn.title: Install Maktaba on a Synology NAS
install.syn.intro: On DSM 7.2 or newer, Maktaba runs as one Container Manager project: Synology's own way to run a compose file. It takes about 15 minutes, and Maktaba updates itself after that.
install.syn.private: Your answers stay in this page: nothing is sent anywhere.
install.syn.fitsMore: Fits with more memory: {tier} with {max} GB
install.syn.modelsNote: Maktaba needs a NAS that reports at least 3.5 GiB of memory (a "4 GB" model). Below that, setup refuses, and the NAS can still hold the library for a Maktaba home on another computer. Maktaba checks the memory and the GPU itself: this table only helps you choose.
install.syn.tiers: Light: speech to text off until you turn it on (base, in the quiet hours), one video conversion at a time up to 720p. Standard: speech to text with small, two conversions. Strong: everything at full size. Heavy work waits for the quiet hours (01:00 to 06:00) on Light and Standard, so the NAS stays quick for its own files.
install.syn.prepare.admin: A DSM account with admin rights, and Container Manager installed from Package Center.
install.syn.prepare.ssd: An SSD volume, if the NAS has one: Maktaba keeps its database there, and browsing is faster.
install.syn.prepare.shares: The shared folders that hold your videos, and which of them Maktaba may write to (for subtitles, conversions and downloads).
install.syn.noPackage: Maktaba is not in Package Center: a Container Manager project needs nothing signed by Synology, and it is how Jellyfin and Immich run on Synology too.
install.syn.model.otherGpu: Another Intel model with Quick Sync
install.syn.model.other: Another Intel or AMD model, without Quick Sync
install.syn.field.uid: The uid of the DSM user maktaba
install.syn.field.uid.help: Step 1 below shows how to read it. The group is always users (100).
install.syn.field.volume.help: The folder is /{volume}/docker/maktaba. Choose an SSD volume if there is one.
install.syn.field.hostIp: This NAS's address on your network (optional)
install.syn.field.tag.help: latest is the newest stable release; Maktaba keeps itself up to date either way.
install.syn.problem.uid: Enter the uid as a number, such as 1026.
install.syn.problem.renderGid: Enter the group as a number, such as 937.
install.syn.problem.volume: Enter a volume such as volume1.
install.syn.problem.sharePath: Enter a folder on a volume, such as /volume1/Movies, with no colon, quote or # in it.
install.syn.problem.shareTwice: This folder is already in the list.
install.syn.problem.hostIp: Enter an address such as 192.168.1.20, or leave it empty.
install.syn.problem.tz: Enter a time zone such as Asia/Riyadh, or leave it empty.
install.syn.problem.tag: Enter latest or a version such as v0.3.130.
install.syn.tooSmall: With {ram} GB this NAS has too little memory for Maktaba, and setup will refuse. It can still store the library for a Maktaba home on another computer.
install.syn.result.j4125: This is the J4125 version: Quick Sync through /dev/dri.
install.syn.result.plain: This is the version for models without Quick Sync: video is converted in software, so players play files as they are when they can.
install.syn.fixFirst: Fix the answers above to get the file.
install.syn.step1.title: 1. Create the DSM user maktaba
install.syn.step1.body: Control Panel → User & Group → Create: name maktaba, a strong password, no administrator rights, no applications. Then read its uid: Control Panel → Task Scheduler → Create → Scheduled Task → User-defined script, user root, script id maktaba > /volume1/docker/maktaba-id.txt; Run it once, open the file in File Station, and delete the task. Over SSH, id maktaba says the same. The uid is 1026 or higher.
install.syn.step2.title: 2. Create Maktaba's folder
install.syn.step2.body: In File Station, create the folder maktaba inside the shared folder docker (Container Manager makes docker; on an SSD volume, make the shared folder there). Properties → Permission → Create: user maktaba, Read/Write.
install.syn.step3.title: 3. Give maktaba its shared folders
install.syn.step3.body: Control Panel → Shared Folder → each folder with videos → Edit → Permissions: Read/Write for maktaba where Maktaba may save subtitles, conversions and downloads, Read only everywhere else. Mark the read-only ones Read only in the answers above too: the file mounts them read-only, so Maktaba cannot change them.
install.syn.step4.title: 4. Create the project
install.syn.step4.body: Container Manager → Project → Create: name maktaba, path docker/maktaba, source Create docker-compose.yml. Paste the file above, then Next and Done. Container Manager downloads the image and starts it.
install.syn.step5.title: 5. Finish setup
install.syn.step5.body: Open http://<your NAS>:8088 in a browser and follow setup: the admin account, then your libraries. Settings → This machine then shows the user Maktaba runs as, its tier and whether video uses Quick Sync.
install.syn.after.firewall: Firewall: if DSM's firewall is on, Control Panel → Security → Firewall → Edit Rules → Create: ports 8088 (the web app), 8080 (apps and the home's other machines) and 8081 (live TV), TCP, from your network only.
install.syn.after.ports: Ports: DSM keeps 80, 443, 5000 and 5001, and its own database keeps 5432; Maktaba uses none of them.
install.syn.after.https: HTTPS: Maktaba's own remote access, with its HTTPS name, is the simplest path. A DSM reverse proxy also works (Control Panel → Login Portal → Advanced → Reverse Proxy, to localhost:8088) with the WebSocket headers added under Custom Header.
install.syn.after.video: Hardware video: on a J4125 model, This machine says "Video: hardware (iHD)". If it names a group to add, stop the project, put that group under group_add in its YAML and build it again.
install.syn.after.plugins: Plugins: DSM's kernel has no Landlock, so Maktaba isolates plugins inside its container (the Container level). Third-party plugins wait until an admin allows them in Settings → Plugins.
install.syn.after.inotify: Folder watching: Maktaba scans on a schedule and uses no inotify watches, so you do not need to raise DSM's inotify limit, as some other apps' guides ask.
install.syn.after.folders: DSM's own folders (@eaDir, #recycle, #snapshot) are never added to your libraries.
install.syn.after.admin: Running it as your own admin user also works, but a user made for Maktaba can only reach the folders you give it.
install.syn.after.encrypted: Encrypted shared folders: until you unlock one, its libraries show No access. Nothing in them is deleted or scanned as missing.
install.syn.trouble.write: The container stops at once: its log (Container → maktaba → Log) names the folder and the uid. Give that user Read/Write on docker/maktaba (step 2) and start the project again.
install.syn.trouble.noAccess: A library shows No access: give maktaba permission on that shared folder (step 3), then press Check access on the library's page.
install.syn.trouble.memory: Setup says there is not enough memory: Maktaba needs 3.5 GiB. Add memory if the model takes it, or use the NAS as storage for a Maktaba home on another computer.
install.syn.trouble.port: The web app does not open: another app on the NAS may hold port 8088, 8080 or 8081. Maktaba's log says which port; stop that app or move it to another port.
